Jesse is with the army at the Salado, 58.1 miles from your land.

Bowie and Fannin are taking a division ahead to the missions. Does Jesse go with them?

Jesse goes ahead with Bowie and Fannin
With the division, ahead of the army.
Jesse stays with the main army
With the main body, under Austin.
Send for Jesse
They leave the ranks and start home. Whatever the army does next happens without them.
